verdict.rationale: Jules docs describe GitHub integration (label-based task assignment, PR creation) and community evidence confirms working GitHub integrations and PR generation, implying a connect-your-repo flow rather than complex manual setup. However, there's no explicit documentation of a literal 'one-click install' flow, OAuth/app installation screen, or setup steps described in evidence, and some users report friction (monorepo confusion, babysitting needed). Missing for 10: explicit one-click GitHub App install documentation, screenshots/steps of the connection flow, and independent confirmation of setup simplicity.
